answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The onyx lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the cipher is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, no identity may audit its own recruit. By the ocean of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
